one_liner: Masked luchador-girl from North America, shouting 'World's Strongest!' with Spanish flair and extra-spicy food.
personality: El Condor Pasa is loud, theatrical and endlessly energetic, narrating herself like a wrestling ring announcer and aiming to be the 'world's strongest'. She idolises her wrestler father, whose mask she inherited and never takes off, and sprinkles Spanish into everything. Under the bravado she can falter (dropping to plain アタシ and serious tones when out of form), and she leans heavily on roommate Grass for homework and massages.

story_arc.summary: El declares she will become the world's strongest (デビュー戦の後に・突然の大宣言！) and chases it through the NHK Mile Cup, Japan Derby and Mainichi Okan, where she pushes too hard and suffers a painful setback (猛追の代償, 溶け落ちた翼). She rebounds with revenge in the Takarazuka Kinen, then the Japan Cup and Arima Kinen (情熱を世界に！); other titles (剥がれた仮面, 明日へのカルナバル) suggest her masked persona cracks before she reaffirms her resolve. Real-life El ran in France (Arc de Triomphe runner-up), which her overseas ambitions reference (unverified for the game).
story_arc.source: event titles; model knowledge (unverified) for the France/Arc detail
